source: This is a handbook about learned representations. It touches dense retrieval, ZXNAME0000XZ, multimodal models, and vector indexes only to explain how embeddings are produced and compared. HNSW, hybrid search, reranking, chunking, and full retrieval-system design belong in their own handbooks.
